019/**

024  /**
025   * Cleanup transaction messages that saved in database

031  /**

045  CompletableFuture<@NotNull Long> createData(@NotNull Shop shop);

047  /**

117  @NotNull

120  void insertTransactionRecord(@Nullable UUID from, @Nullable UUID to, double amount, @Nullable String currency, double taxAmount, @Nullable UUID taxAccount, @Nullable String error);

122  @NotNull
123  List<ShopRecord> listShops(boolean deleteIfCorrupt);

153  /**
154   * Locate a shop record from database by shop record id

156   * @param shopId The shop record id

161  CompletableFuture<@Nullable Long> locateShopDataId(long shopId);

163  /**
164   * Locate a shop record from database by location

170   *
171   * @return The shop record id
172   */

174
175  /**
176   * Remove a data record from database
177   *
178   * @param dataId The data record id

181  CompletableFuture<@NotNull Integer> removeData(long dataId);
182
183  /**
184   * Remove a shop data record from database
185   *
186   * @param shopId The shop record id
187   */

189  CompletableFuture<@NotNull Integer> removeShop(long shopId);

191
192  /**
193   * Remove a shop data mapping record from database

197   * @param y     Shop Y
198   * @param z     Shop Z

201  CompletableFuture<@NotNull Integer> removeShopMap(@NotNull String world, int x, int y, int z);

203  /**
204   * Create a transaction message record and save into database

206   * @param player  Target player

209   */

211  CompletableFuture<@NotNull Integer> saveOfflineTransactionMessage(@NotNull UUID player, @NotNull String message, long time);
212
213  /**
214   * Select all messages that saved in the database

223  /**
224   * Select player messages that saved in the database

229  CompletableFuture<List<String>> selectPlayerMessages(UUID player);

231  /**
232   * Select specific table content

234   * @return Query result set
235   *
236   * @throws SQLException Any errors related to SQL Errors
237   */

239  SQLQuery selectTable(@NotNull String table) throws SQLException;
240
241  CompletableFuture<Integer> updatePlayerProfile(@NotNull UUID uuid, @Nullable String locale, @NotNull String username);
242
243  /**
244   * Update player profiles in batch
245   *
246   * @param uuidLocaleUsername left=uuid, middle=locale, right=username

252  /**

262  /**

269  CompletableFuture<@NotNull ShopInventoryCountCache> queryInventoryCache(long shopId);
